summary: The verified source contract caps every legal column title at seven characters, which is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict by input length.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source-fidelity-verified constraint is 1 <= columnTitle.length <= 7 with titles no larger than FXSHRXW.

replacement_checks.evidence: The loop visits each of the n title characters once and performs one character-to-digit conversion plus one Horner update. It stores only the running total and current character, proving O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition, including the app-local conversion and integer return path.
